# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 97 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 97 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_097_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 9, Chapter 14

**1** "All these," he said, "are glorious angels. The Lord is encircled by them. But the gate is the Son of God; he is the only entrance to the Lord. **2** No one shall enter in to the Lord except through him. Do not suppose that anyone can enter by any other way than through the Son." **3** I said, "I understand, Lord. But who are the six men who carried the stones?" **4** "These are the six holy angels of God who preside over all the virtues — the first things created by God; to these the Lord has entrusted the whole creation to increase it and build it up. Through these six angels the tower is completed." **5** "And who are the others who are bringing the stones?" I asked. **6** "These also are holy angels of the Lord; but the six are set over them. When the building of the tower is completed, all of them together will feast in the presence of the Lord. **7** They will rejoice with the Lord over the completion of the tower." **8** I said, "Lord, I want to know what the stones are." **9** "The square white stones that fit together perfectly — these are the apostles and bishops and teachers and deacons who walked in the holiness of God and governed and taught and ministered to the elect of God in purity and reverence. **10** Some of them have fallen asleep and some are still living. They always agreed with one another and were at peace with one another; therefore their joints with one another are exact — they fit the building of the tower perfectly."

---

*LOGOS: the four-fold ordained ministry (apostoloi, episkopoi, didaskaloi, diakonoi) in v. 9 is one of the earliest such lists in Christian literature, predating later hierarchical development.*
